title: Vizag Port Trust Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 20 Trade Apprentice Posts
description: Visakhapatnam Port Authority (VPA) has released the official notification for 2026. Allotted 20 Trade Apprentice Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the ITI can grab this chance and apply for the Vizag Port Trust Notification 2026 . Here, we have included more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
